name: AI for Database
summary: Natural-language access to your own databases: ask questions in plain English, get answers with charts, saved SQL, dashboards, scheduled workflows and alerts, with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and Google Sheets connections.
best_for: small teams without a data analyst who want to ask their own database questions in plain English and turn the answers into dashboards and scheduled alerts
skip_if: you need a fixed monthly price with no usage credits, require SSO on a standard plan, or want a free AI allowance you can rely on
honest_knock: The homepage says "Free plan available - No credit card required", but the pricing FAQ says AI usage requires credits, so we could not confirm any free AI allowance beyond the sample-data start. The price page does not say how many questions a dollar of credit buys. SSO/SAML is not included in Pro or Team, and the self-hosted price is not published.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · Pro billed monthly per user, excluding taxes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-05 on aifordatabase.com/pricing) AI for Database sells per user, and every payment turns into that user's own AI credits. Pro costs $10 per user per month and adds $10 of credits per payment; Team costs $30 per user per month and adds $30 of credits per payment, plus per-user usage tracking, assigned connections, audit logs and shared dashboards and workflows. Annual billing is 20% less than twelve monthly payments: $96 per user for Pro and $288 per user for Team, with the full amount added as credits. Credits do not expire and do not reset each month. AI usage pauses when a user's balance runs out; a user can top up with $10, $25, $50 or $100. Prices and credits exclude applicable taxes. Enterprise is custom priced and covers SSO requirements, security reviews and contract terms; the pricing page says SSO/SAML is not included in Pro or Team. Self-hosting is available separately and its price is not published. The pricing page does not say how many questions a dollar of credit buys, so the real monthly cost depends on how much you ask.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AI for Database on its built-in demo database: one suggested question answered in 8 seconds with a table, a chart and the generated SQL, the Billing page with $1.00 of credits and no subscription, the plan cards with Pro at $20 and Team at $50 per user per month and the external Dodo Payments checkout for Pro yearly, which was opened but not filled in. No own database was connected and nothing was paid. The test ran on the built-in demo database (Lumastack demo database) in an account that we made, in the Free organization plan, on 17 November 2026 from 13:48. The app was opened in our own tab and was already in English. The first screen said Ask my database anything and Select a project above to start querying your databases., with a badge SAMPLE and a button Connect my DB; the data source list said No projects yet. Core action, one question on the demo database: no project and no connection was needed. One click on the suggested question Which plan brings in the most monthly revenue? ran on the sample database. The answer stood within 8 seconds, in 1 click and 2 steps (TRACE 2 STEPS 1 QUERIES), with the label QRY VERIFIED and a table of 3 rows in 1 ms: growth 1.213.900 cents and 61 subscriptions, scale 1.147.700 and 23, starter 450.800 and 92 (MRR $12,139, $11,477 and $4,508). The text said The growth plan brings in the most monthly revenue at $12,139, slightly ahead of the scale plan ($11,477)., with a bar chart and a tip to upsell starter customers. VIEW SQL shows GENERATED SQL, a SELECT that sums mrr_cents per plan and counts subscriptions (the line is cut off in the view), and READ subscriptions. The buttons are Pin to dashboard, Watch this, Export and Retry. A note under the answer says the answer used demo data and asks to run it on your own database with a dedicated read-only database user. Own database: NOT connected, because we do not enter real database passwords; the app asks for an own database and a dedicated read-only database user. So the quality of answers on a real database was not tested. Plans: Settings, Billing shows Available credits $1.00 (Your individual credits. No expiry or monthly reset.) and No active subscription. The box to turn on auto top-up on Pro (add $10 from the card you subscribe with when anyone's credits drop below $2, up to $100 a month) is ticked by default; the top-up amounts are $10, $25, $50 and $100, and on Pro AI usage pauses when the balance runs out. The plan cards show Pro at $20 per user / month billed monthly with $20 in credits per user, per payment (Yearly, Save 20%: $192 a year), Team at $50 per user / month billed monthly with Unlimited AI usage, and Enterprise with Custom and Contact sales. The dossier of 5 November says Pro $10 and Team $30 per user per month and $96 and $288 a year; the app now shows $20 and $50 and $192 for Pro a year, so the dossier prices are out of date. Checkout: Choose Pro (yearly) opened the external checkout of Dodo Payments in Dutch (our browser language) for AI for Database Pro, annual, per seat: $192.00 per year, VAT $40.32, total $232.32, with contact fields (the e-mail address was prefilled), a billing address and the button Ga door naar Betaling. We stopped there: nothing was entered and nothing was paid. Cancelling: there was no active subscription, so no cancel button was visible. Settings has the tabs Workspace, Members, API keys, Billing and Audit log, with no Delete account or Cancel option, and Billing has no cancel button as long as nothing was paid. The cancellation route and the account deletion were therefore not seen. Not tested: connecting an own database, the Team features (usage per member, audit log, assigned connections), dashboards, workflows, webhooks, AI assistants, inviting members and the payment itself. Clean up: the account and the test data remain: two chats with the question Which plan brings in the most monthly revenue? in Recent and one open checkout session that was not paid and expires by itself. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The answers were only seen on demo data, auto top-up on Pro is ticked by default, AI usage on Pro pauses when the credits run out, the plan prices in the dossier are out of date, the external checkout runs in Dutch and shows VAT on top, and no cancel or delete option was visible before a subscription.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AI for Database on its built-in demo database: one suggested question answered in 8 seconds with a table, a chart and the generated SQL, the Billing page with $1.00 of credits and no subscription, the plan cards with Pro at $20 and Team at $50 per user per month and the external Dodo Payments checkout for Pro yearly, which was opened but not filled in. No own database was connected and nothing was paid. The test ran on the built-in demo database (Lumastack demo database) in an account that we made, in the Free organization plan, on 17 November 2026 from 13:48. The app was opened in our own tab and was already in English. The first screen said Ask my database anything and Select a project above to start querying your databases., with a badge SAMPLE and a button Connect my DB; the data source list said No projects yet. Core action, one question on the demo database: no project and no connection was needed. One click on the suggested question Which plan brings in the most monthly revenue? ran on the sample database. The answer stood within 8 seconds, in 1 click and 2 steps (TRACE 2 STEPS 1 QUERIES), with the label QRY VERIFIED and a table of 3 rows in 1 ms: growth 1.213.900 cents and 61 subscriptions, scale 1.147.700 and 23, starter 450.800 and 92 (MRR $12,139, $11,477 and $4,508). The text said The growth plan brings in the most monthly revenue at $12,139, slightly ahead of the scale plan ($11,477)., with a bar chart and a tip to upsell starter customers. VIEW SQL shows GENERATED SQL, a SELECT that sums mrr_cents per plan and counts subscriptions (the line is cut off in the view), and READ subscriptions. The buttons are Pin to dashboard, Watch this, Export and Retry. A note under the answer says the answer used demo data and asks to run it on your own database with a dedicated read-only database user. Own database: NOT connected, because we do not enter real database passwords; the app asks for an own database and a dedicated read-only database user. So the quality of answers on a real database was not tested. Plans: Settings, Billing shows Available credits $1.00 (Your individual credits. No expiry or monthly reset.) and No active subscription. The box to turn on auto top-up on Pro (add $10 from the card you subscribe with when anyone's credits drop below $2, up to $100 a month) is ticked by default; the top-up amounts are $10, $25, $50 and $100, and on Pro AI usage pauses when the balance runs out. The plan cards show Pro at $20 per user / month billed monthly with $20 in credits per user, per payment (Yearly, Save 20%: $192 a year), Team at $50 per user / month billed monthly with Unlimited AI usage, and Enterprise with Custom and Contact sales. The dossier of 5 November says Pro $10 and Team $30 per user per month and $96 and $288 a year; the app now shows $20 and $50 and $192 for Pro a year, so the dossier prices are out of date. Checkout: Choose Pro (yearly) opened the external checkout of Dodo Payments in Dutch (our browser language) for AI for Database Pro, annual, per seat: $192.00 per year, VAT $40.32, total $232.32, with contact fields (the e-mail address was prefilled), a billing address and the button Ga door naar Betaling. We stopped there: nothing was entered and nothing was paid. Cancelling: there was no active subscription, so no cancel button was visible. Settings has the tabs Workspace, Members, API keys, Billing and Audit log, with no Delete account or Cancel option, and Billing has no cancel button as long as nothing was paid. The cancellation route and the account deletion were therefore not seen. Not tested: connecting an own database, the Team features (usage per member, audit log, assigned connections), dashboards, workflows, webhooks, AI assistants, inviting members and the payment itself. Clean up: the account and the test data remain: two chats with the question Which plan brings in the most monthly revenue? in Recent and one open checkout session that was not paid and expires by itself. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The answers were only seen on demo data, auto top-up on Pro is ticked by default, AI usage on Pro pauses when the credits run out, the plan prices in the dossier are out of date, the external checkout runs in Dutch and shows VAT on top, and no cancel or delete option was visible before a subscription.
